Published pp. 6–7 contain multiple omnibus chi-square tests and simple-slope/contrast tests for doping likelihood, anticipated guilt, moral disengagement and self-regulatory efficacy. Requested test-statistic metric and generic description do not identify a unique outcome or test. Both primary papers were obtained and their titles/DOIs verified via university-hosted full PDFs. Page-only locators plus a generic paper-level description do not uniquely identify the assigned effect. No effect, p value or analytic n was selected arbitrarily. Authors report broad paper-level replication success; the recorded verdict is paper-level and does not establish success for this unidentified target. Original Table 5 offers both ITT and per-protocol estimates; replication Tables 3–4 use different time coding and include a no-intervention control, so rows must not be silently equated.
